browser.renderer: ANGLE (Apple, ANGLE Metal Renderer: Apple M4, Unspecified Version)

art.kind: Fixed posed scenes; real hardware WebGL. Close frames are .32 seconds after answering.

checks: direct intro with delayed bytes keeps and plays the first Kyoto line
next interrupts first line and speaks second
practice replaces the dialogue with the first teaching word
music and voice produce concurrent PCM without ducking, restarting or compressor pumping
all manifested voice assets decode to nonempty PCM
rush keeps one latest voice without a queue
mute stops all recorded voices and music
native context suspend and gesture resume restore the existing music engine
normal START title completion automatically plays first Kyoto line
failed download displays retry and retries the same first line
zero SpeechSynthesis speak/cancel/resume calls across all navigations and zero browser errors
audio.kind: Real AudioContext analyser and real MP3 decode; no subjective/speaker claim.

limitations: Mac Chrome / Apple M4. No physical iPhone/iPad Safari or human timing/input acceptance.
Visual match recordings mock the shared voice entry and read answers in the test driver. They are not listening or difficulty tests.
Contact sound event timing is checked in VM. Web Audio output is measured; hit/guard sound quality is not subjectively auditioned.
Fixed art shots set each reaction and phase time; continuous matches are the separate native-RAF recordings.
